environmental_feedback: Public source publication was fully automatable with the existing GitHub authorization.
A real Base-mainnet x402 challenge no longer requires CDP credentials when a live public facilitator is selected.
Temporary tunnel availability is not equivalent to durable hosting and failed this bounded attempt.
The human-confirmed Render Blueprint produced a durable public hostname and passed health/payment-challenge probes.
The public hostname is not yet continuously available; intermittent x-render-routing:no-server responses make first-buyer delivery unreliable until the Render deployment stabilizes.
